external_primary.title: Instruct-FD: Can Your Full-Duplex Speech System Follow Turn-Taking Instructions?
external_primary.admitted_method: Treat explicit requested turn-management behavior as an independent experimental variable and compare matched conversational stimuli under different policies.

source_observations: VoiceInputPacket already carries overlap_state and barge_in.
VoiceOutputPacket already carries speech_act plus playback/cancellation state.
VoicePacketCortex.accept_input propagates barge-in cancellation for barge_in=true.

Current direct packet-cortex tests exercise deterministic barge-in interruption, WAIT/BACKCHANNEL intents, tool ownership, causal ordering, recovery, fail-closed checkpoint binding and latency accounting.

The inspected packet schema and direct packet-cortex test fixtures do not expose an explicit per-turn turn-policy identifier/reference. This is not proof of system-wide absence: an upstream authority may compile policy into packet fields/provenance before the packet-cortex boundary.
